searchText: Hi! I am trying to run the electra spec tests, but battling some python dependency issues related to the LRU package. Is it this package? https://pypi.org/project/lru/ Does not seem maintained, getting this when trying to install: ``` Collecting lru Using cached lru-0.1.tar.gz (1.1 kB) Installing build dependencies ... done Getting requirements to build wheel ... error error: subprocess-exited-with-error × Getting requirements to build wheel did not run successfully. │ exit code: 1 ╰─> [23 lines of output] Traceback (most recent call last): File "/Users/claravanstaden/IdeaProjects/python-light-client/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pip/_vendor/pyproject_hooks/_in_process/_in_process.py", line 353, in <module> main() File "/Users/claravanstaden/IdeaProjects/python-light-client/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pip/_vendor/pyproject_hooks/_in_process/_in_process.py", line 335, in main json_out['return_val'] = hook(**hook_input['kwargs']) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ... exec(code, locals()) File "<string>", line 2, in <module> File "/private/var/folders/f0/sxwmq3z53hnfwfn804_k0kph0000gn/T/pip-install-tp1bfvpp/lru_73f320a6d6ef4e79b85df9d34a16ecca/lru.py", line 18 raise KeyError, key ^ SyntaxError: invalid syntax [end of output] note: This error originates from a subprocess, and is likely not a problem with pip. error: subprocess-exited-with-error × Getting requirements to build wheel did not run successfully. │ exit code: 1 ╰─> See above for output. ``` Magically fixed itself 🔮
